title: all I know
lyrics:

[00:15.92]All I know is I don't know nothing at all

[00:46.68]All I know is I don't know nothing at all

[01:19.36]Let me know
[01:20.35]Yeah

[01:23.95]All I know is I don't know nothing at all
[01:26.97]People talk but they don't say nothing
[01:30.16]All I know is I don't know nothing at all
[01:33.34]Ripped jeans, I've been running from the cops all night
[01:36.68]I'm dead, I don't care about nothing
[01:39.50]Bloody teeth in my mouth when I smiled last night
